sentences.zh: 佛朗哥最初并没有打算把烈士谷

sentences.zh: 西班牙主要盟友之一施加的压力所做出的扭曲回应。

sentences.en: The Americans relied on Spain as one of
sentences.zh: 美国在冷战期间将西班牙视为

sentences.zh: 其欧洲伙伴之一。

sentences.en: And when they heard about Franco's plans for the Valley
sentences.zh: 当他们听说佛朗哥关于烈士谷的计划时，

sentences.en: of the Fallen, they started to get nervous.
sentences.zh: 他们开始感到不安。

sentences.en: The monument was shaping up to be pretty confrontational
sentences.zh: 这座纪念碑看起来极具对抗性

sentences.en: and divisive.
sentences.zh: 且容易引发分裂。

sentences.en: The Americans hoped Franco would dial it back a bit to make it a place that memorial
sentences.zh: 美国人希望佛朗哥能稍微收敛一点，将其建成一个纪念

sentences.en: all the country's war dead, not just the Catholic crusaders.
sentences.zh: 全国战争死难者的地方，而不仅仅是纪念天主教十字军。

sentences.en: And so Franco declared the Valley of
sentences.zh: 于是佛朗哥宣布烈士谷

sentences.en: the Fallen to be a place of reconciliation, a place where the dead from both sides of the civil war
sentences.zh: 是一个和解之地，一个让内战双方死者

sentences.en: would be laid to reSt. But then, once again, Franco went about making that happen in the most
sentences.zh: 安息的地方。但随后，佛朗哥再次以最

sentences.en: fascist way possible.
sentences.zh: 法西斯的方式去实现这一目标。

sentences.en: So Franco and I said, well, we're going to do this as a place of reconciliation.
sentences.zh: 所以佛朗哥和我当时说，好吧，我们要把它建成一个和解之地。

sentences.en: Purificacion La Peña says that Franco ordered his people to bring him bodies from mass graves
sentences.zh: 普里菲卡西翁·拉·佩尼亚说，佛朗哥下令手下从西班牙各地的万人坑

sentences.en: and cemeteries all over Spain.
sentences.zh: 和墓地把尸体运来。

sentences.en: They dug the bodies up without permission and jumbled them
sentences.zh: 他们未经许可就挖出尸体，把它们

sentences.en: together in boxes.
sentences.zh: 混装在盒子里。

sentences.en: Then they drove them to the Valley, where they were reburied in the crypt near the Basilica.
sentences.zh: 然后把它们运到烈士谷，重新安葬在圣殿附近的地下室里。

sentences.en: Finally completed, the valley opened to the public in 1959.
sentences.zh: 烈士谷最终于1959年向公众开放。

sentences.en: Nearly two decades later, when Franco finally died of heart failure, he too was buried at the
sentences.zh: 近二十年后，当佛朗哥最终因心脏衰竭去世时，他也同样被埋葬在

sentences.en: Valley of the Fallen.
sentences.zh: 烈士谷。

sentences.en: He was laid to rest in a grand basilica above the bodies of the Spaniards
sentences.zh: 他被安葬在宏伟的圣殿中，就在那些他曾

sentences.en: he had tortured, killed, and then reburied in a mass grave, where their families couldn't find them.
sentences.zh: 折磨、杀害并重新埋入万人坑，以致家人无法寻回的西班牙人的遗体之上。

sentences.en: And with Franco gone, Spain suddenly confronted a new future without El Gaudillo.
sentences.zh: 随着佛朗哥的离去，西班牙突然面临一个没有“领袖”的新未来。

sentences.en: Well, look, when Franco died, we were very happy to get rid of him.
sentences.zh: 你看，佛朗哥死的时候，我们很高兴能摆脱他。

sentences.en: We were expecting that,
sentences.zh: 我们一直在期待那一刻，

sentences.en: and we had the freezer full of champagne.
sentences.zh: 冰箱里都装满了香槟。

sentences.en: The three years between Franco's death and the signing of a new constitution became known
sentences.zh: 佛朗哥去世到签署新宪法之间的三年被称为

sentences.en: as the Transition.
sentences.zh: “转型期”。

sentences.en: The country moved from fascist dictatorship to multi-party democracy.
sentences.zh: 国家从法西斯独裁转向了多党民主。

sentences.en: And starting in the late 1970s, Spain finally got to do what the U.S., Britain, and France
sentences.zh: 从20世纪70年代末开始，西班牙终于做到了美国、英国和法国

sentences.en: had done more than a decade before.
sentences.zh: 十多年前就已经做到的事情。

sentences.en: They got to have fun.
sentences.zh: 他们开始享受生活了。

sentences.en: A new, revolutionary movement sprang up in Madrid
sentences.zh: 一场新的革命运动在马德里兴起，

sentences.en: and became known as La Movida Madrileña.
sentences.zh: 被称为“马德里运动”。

sentences.en: La Movida has consumed Madrid, transforming the capital into Europe's new movable feaSt.
sentences.zh: 这场运动席卷了马德里，将首都变成了欧洲新的“流动的盛宴”。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Spaniards could drink, dance, have sex outside of marriage, and make music about it.
sentences.zh: 突然间，西班牙人可以喝酒、跳舞、婚前性行为，并以此为题材创作音乐。

sentences.en: The transition seemed to have ushered in a new Spain.
sentences.zh: 转型似乎开启了一个新的西班牙。

sentences.en: But the elation felt after Franco's death was temporary.
sentences.zh: 但佛朗哥死后的那种狂喜只是暂时的。

sentences.en: It's only after several years that you realize that new democracy hasn't solved all the problems
sentences.zh: 几年后你才会意识到，新的民主并没有解决独裁统治带来的

sentences.en: that were brought by the dictatorship.
sentences.zh: 所有问题。

sentences.en: For one thing, there were reminders of the dictatorship everywhere.
sentences.zh: 首先，独裁统治的痕迹随处可见。

sentences.en: There were statues of Franco and his collaborators in central plazas all over the country.
sentences.zh: 全国各地的中心广场上都有佛朗哥及其合作者的雕像。

sentences.en: His name was on street signs.
sentences.zh: 他的名字出现在街道标志上。

sentences.en: And of course, the Valley of the Fallen served as a colossal reminder.
sentences.zh: 当然，烈士谷本身就是一个巨大的提醒。

sentences.en: How can you have a democracy and at the same time have a huge monument
sentences.zh: 你怎么能既拥有民主，同时又保留一座由政治犯建造的、

sentences.en: to the glory of the dictatorship built by political prisoners?
sentences.zh: 歌颂独裁统治的巨大纪念碑呢？

sentences.en: But perhaps the biggest hurdle to fully addressing what had happened to the country under Franco
sentences.zh: 但也许全面解决佛朗哥统治下国家所发生的一切的最大障碍，

sentences.en: was an agreement that became known as the Pacto del Olvido.
sentences.zh: 是一项被称为“遗忘公约”的协议。

sentences.en: The Pact of Forgetting.
sentences.zh: 遗忘的契约。

sentences.en: Es simplemente un olvido.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹就是遗忘。

sentences.en: Una amnistía de todos para todos.
sentences.zh: 一个所有人的大赦。

sentences.en: Un olvido de todos para todos.
sentences.zh: 一个所有人的遗忘。

sentences.en: As one politician said, the Pacto would be an amnesty for everyone.
sentences.zh: 正如一位政治家所说，该公约将是对所有人的大赦。

sentences.en: Agreed to by everyone.
sentences.zh: 每个人都同意了。

sentences.en: At the heart of the Pact of Forgetting was legal forgiveness for all Franco-era crimes.
sentences.zh: “遗忘公约”的核心是对佛朗哥时代的所有罪行进行法律上的宽恕。

sentences.en: It was a deal agreed to by parties on the right and the left.
sentences.zh: 这是右翼和左翼政党达成的一项协议。

sentences.en: It was a massive compromise.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的妥协。

sentences.en: The whole process of transition to democracy was a transaction.
sentences.zh: 整个向民主转型的过程是一场交易。

sentences.en: It was a deal.
sentences.zh: 这是一笔买卖。

sentences.en: It was a negotiation.
sentences.zh: 这是一场谈判。

sentences.en: Paul Preston again.
sentences.zh: 保罗·普雷斯顿再次强调。

sentences.en: Moderation, compromise, sacrifice was the only chance of getting even a glimmer of democracy.
sentences.zh: 温和、妥协、牺牲是获得哪怕一丝民主希望的唯一机会。

sentences.en: So that's the context.
sentences.zh: 这就是背景。

sentences.en: The left agreed to the Pact because they wanted their political prisoners freed
sentences.zh: 左翼同意该公约，因为他们希望释放政治犯，

sentences.en: and their political parties legalized.
sentences.zh: 并使他们的政党合法化。

sentences.en: They wanted to be able to live in this new democracy without fear of being tortured or murdered.
sentences.zh: 他们希望能够生活在这个新的民主国家中，而不必担心被折磨或谋杀。

sentences.en: But as time went on, they had to grapple with the fact
sentences.zh: 但随着时间的推移，他们不得不面对一个事实：

sentences.en: that the amnesty applied to people on the right, too.
sentences.zh: 大赦也适用于右翼人士。

sentences.en: Well, we thought that the amnesty was an amnesty for the few who left in political parties.
sentences.zh: 我们以为大赦只是针对少数留在政党里的人。

sentences.en: Fausto Canales was a left-wing activist back in the late 70s when the Pact of Forgetting went into effect.
sentences.zh: 法乌斯托·卡纳莱斯在70年代末“遗忘公约”生效时是一名左翼活动家。

sentences.en: He knew back then that his father had disappeared during the civil war, when Fausto was just two years old.
sentences.zh: 他当时就知道他的父亲在内战期间失踪了，那时法乌斯托才两岁。

sentences.en: And he says that instead of making sure people on the left wouldn't be persecuted for their political views,
sentences.zh: 他说，大赦法并没有确保左翼人士不会因政治观点而受到迫害，

sentences.en: the amnesty law was primarily used to shield those on the right who'd killed civilians.
sentences.zh: 反而主要被用来保护那些杀害平民的右翼分子。

sentences.en: Fausto says when he realized what had happened, he put his head in his hands.
sentences.zh: 法乌斯托说，当他意识到发生了什么时，他双手抱头。

sentences.en: He felt he'd been tricked.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己被骗了。

sentences.en: Pact created a culture of silence around the atrocities of Spain's paSt.
sentences.zh: 该公约在西班牙的过去暴行周围制造了一种沉默的文化。

sentences.en: It suppressed conversations about the killing of civilians during the civil war
sentences.zh: 它压制了关于内战期间杀害平民以及

sentences.en: and the long years of repression that followed.
sentences.zh: 随后的多年镇压的讨论。

sentences.en: The pact basically said, let's just not talk about what happened.
sentences.zh: 该公约基本上说，我们还是别谈过去发生的事了。

sentences.en: Let's move forward instead.
sentences.zh: 我们还是向前看吧。

sentences.en: And as for the Valley of the Fallen, it became something like a shrine to Franco.
sentences.zh: 至于烈士谷，它成了佛朗哥的圣地。

sentences.en: Fascists would visit it from all over Europe to pay their respects
sentences.zh: 来自欧洲各地的法西斯分子会来此瞻仰，

sentences.en: and would mark his death with flowers every year.
sentences.zh: 并每年在他的忌日献花纪念。

sentences.en: Franco was remembered, even as the pact ensured that his crimes were slowly forgotten and erased.
sentences.zh: 佛朗哥被人们铭记，而该公约却确保了他的罪行被慢慢遗忘和抹除。

sentences.en: For people like Purificación, the pact just didn't work.
sentences.zh: 对于像普里菲卡西翁这样的人来说，该公约根本行不通。

sentences.en: It was impossible to move forward without knowing exactly what had happened to her relatives.
sentences.zh: 如果不确切知道她的亲人发生了什么，就不可能向前看。

sentences.en: As time went on, her family, and many others, began to resist the taboo against speaking up.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，她的家人和其他许多人开始反抗这种禁忌。

sentences.en: They began to talk about what they'd been through.
sentences.zh: 他们开始谈论自己的经历。

sentences.en: Purificación says that during the 1980s, discussions that had long been kept quiet
sentences.zh: 普里菲卡西翁说，在20世纪80年代，那些长期被压制的讨论

sentences.en: started to come out into the open.
sentences.zh: 开始公开化。

sentences.en: And even if people didn't want to listen,
sentences.zh: 即使人们不想听，

sentences.en: at least it was no longer unthinkable for families of victims to make their grievances known.
sentences.zh: 至少受害者家属表达不满已不再是不可想象的事情。

sentences.en: And as families began to talk more about what happened to them,
sentences.zh: 随着家属们开始更多地谈论他们的遭遇，

sentences.en: they also started to organize around an important goal.
sentences.zh: 他们也开始围绕一个重要的目标组织起来。

sentences.en: They wanted to find the bodies of their missing family members
sentences.zh: 他们想找到失踪家人的遗体，

sentences.en: that had ended up in the mass graves around the country.
sentences.zh: 这些遗体最终被埋在全国各地的万人坑里。

sentences.en: And they weren't going to wait for the government to give them permission.
sentences.zh: 他们不想再等政府给他们许可了。

sentences.en: They began hiring forensic specialists and archaeologists
sentences.zh: 他们开始聘请法医专家和考古学家，

sentences.en: to help them find and dig up the bodies themselves.
sentences.zh: 帮助他们自己寻找并挖掘遗体。

sentences.en: Miguel Ángel Capapé works for an organization called Arico.
sentences.zh: 米格尔·安赫尔·卡帕佩为一家名为Arico的组织工作。

sentences.en: It carries out private exhumations for families who want to find their murdered relatives.
sentences.zh: 它为那些想要寻找被谋杀亲人的家庭进行私人挖掘。

sentences.en: As Miguel showed me around the headquarters,
sentences.zh: 当米格尔带我参观总部时，

sentences.en: I noticed a wall of boxes and asked what they contained.
sentences.zh: 我注意到墙上有一排盒子，便问里面装的是什么。

sentences.en: He told me that inside were skeletons,
sentences.zh: 他告诉我里面是骨架，

sentences.en: some broken into pieces by torture and the years spent underground,
sentences.zh: 有些因为酷刑和多年埋在地下而碎裂，

sentences.en: now waiting to be washed and identified.
sentences.zh: 现在正等待清洗和鉴定。

sentences.en: I asked him how families typically react
sentences.zh: 我问他家属在看到这些破碎的遗体从地下重见天日时，

sentences.en: to seeing these broken bodies emerge from the ground,
sentences.zh: 在等待了这么久之后，通常会有什么反应。

sentences.en: after waiting for answers for so long.
sentences.zh: 他说，那是一切。

sentences.en: It's everything, he says.
sentences.zh: 尤其是当他们花了多年时间

sentences.en: Especially when they've spent years
sentences.zh: 试图了解亲人被埋在哪里的时候。

sentences.en: trying to learn where their loved ones were buried.
sentences.zh: 举行一场真正的葬礼对人们来说意义重大。

sentences.en: Having a real funeral makes a huge difference to people.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间里，像米格尔这样的人的工作

sentences.en: For a long time, the work of people like Miguel
sentences.zh: 都是在暗中进行，没有得到国家的支持。

sentences.en: happened below the radar and without support from the state.
sentences.zh: 但后来，在2007年，一项新法律生效了，

sentences.en: But then, in 2007, a new law went into effect
sentences.zh: 它推动了这些揭露过去罪行的努力。

sentences.en: that gave a boost to these efforts to uncover the crimes of the paSt.
sentences.zh: 这项新法律被称为《历史记忆法》，

sentences.en: The new law was called the Historical Memory Law,
sentences.zh: 它打破了“遗忘公约”。

sentences.en: and it broke the Pact of Forgetting.
sentences.zh: 佛朗哥时代罪行的受害者第一次

sentences.en: For the first time, victims of Franco-era crimes
sentences.zh: 得到了官方的承认。

sentences.en: received official recognition.
sentences.zh: 得到了官方的承认。

sentences.en: The law called for the removal of Francoist symbols from public places,
sentences.zh: 法律要求清除公共场所的佛朗哥主义标志，

sentences.en: and lots of new money flowed to the exhumation efforts
sentences.zh: 大量新资金涌入挖掘工作，

sentences.en: happening at mass gravesites across the country.
sentences.zh: 这些挖掘工作在全国各地的乱葬岗进行。

sentences.en: Purificación La Peña and her family seized their chance.
sentences.zh: 普里菲卡西翁·拉佩尼亚（Purificación La Peña）和她的家人抓住了机会。

sentences.en: They contacted Eduardo Ranf, a human rights lawyer
sentences.zh: 他们联系了爱德华多·兰夫（Eduardo Ranf），一位人权律师，

sentences.en: who was helping to investigate crimes dating back to the Franco era.
sentences.zh: 他一直在协助调查佛朗哥时代的罪行。

sentences.en: Eduardo started looking into the case
sentences.zh: 爱德华多开始调查普里菲卡西翁的祖父和叔祖父的案件。

sentences.en: of Purificación's grandfather and great-uncle.
sentences.zh: 他了解到，普里菲卡西翁的亲人并不在他们遇害城镇附近的乱葬岗里。

sentences.en: He learned that Purificación's relatives were not in a mass grave near the town where they'd been killed.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们是被转移到“烈士谷”的遗体之一，

sentences.en: Instead, they were among the bodies that had been moved to the Valley of the Fallen
sentences.zh: 时间是在1959年该地开放之前。

sentences.en: before it opened in 1959.
sentences.zh: 他们和其他遗骸一起被混装在盒子里，

sentences.en: They'd been jumbled together in boxes with other remains
sentences.zh: 然后被转移到大教堂的地下室中。

sentences.en: and then transferred into the crypts of the basilica.
sentences.zh: 重新安葬时，他们的名字并没有被记录下来。

sentences.en: When reburied, their names had not been written down.
sentences.zh: 听到这个消息的不仅仅是普里菲卡西翁一家。

sentences.en: And Purificación's family wasn't the only one hearing this.
sentences.zh: 总计约有33,000具遗体被重新安葬在这个纪念碑下。

sentences.en: All told, around 33,000 bodies had been reburied at the monument.
sentences.zh: 普里菲卡西翁最终与30多个家庭联合起来。

sentences.en: Purificación eventually banded together with more than 30 families.
sentences.zh: 他们提起了一系列法律诉讼，

sentences.en: They filed a series of legal complaints that wound their way
sentences.zh: 多年来在地区、国家和欧洲法院之间辗转。

sentences.en: through regional, national, and European courts
sentences.zh: 直到2011年，政府成立了一个专家组，

sentences.en: over the course of many years.
sentences.zh: 来审议“烈士谷”的未来。

sentences.en: And then, in 2011, the government asked a panel of experts
sentences.zh: 专家组建议将佛朗哥的遗体从谷中移走，

sentences.en: to consider the future of the Valley of the Fallen.
sentences.zh: 这对那些长期以来认为该谷是法西斯纪念碑的人来说，

sentences.en: The panel recommended that Franco's body be removed from the valley,
